name: Shortling Alliances
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Tenacious
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, the first time they are attacked each round, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Precision Frenzy
specialRules.description: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Indirect when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Indirect when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Rapid Charge
specialRules.description: This model moves +4" when using Charge actions.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Tenacious Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Tenacious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Swift Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Swift. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Furious Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Relentless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Relentless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Tenacious
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Tenacious, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Tenacious (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Obliterate
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(27) or higher, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

specialRules.name: Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, the first time they are attacked each round, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Guarded, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Guarded (instead of only the first time they are attacked each round).

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Indirect
specialRules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

specialRules.name: Swift
specialRules.description: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
